resources.string: Bandhanhara Bangla — a frequency-optimised Bangla keyboard with big keys
Turn on “বাঁধনহারা বাংলা” in the system keyboard list.
Pick বাঁধনহারা বাংলা as your current keyboard. You can switch back any time with the 🌐 key.

Tap ক for ক, hold it for খ. Every aspirate pair works this way: গ→ঘ, চ→ছ, জ→ঝ, ট→ঠ, ত→থ, দ→ধ, প→ফ, ব→ভ, স→শ, ন→ণ.

Vowels too: hold অ for আ, ই for ঈ, ি for ী, ে for ৈ.

⇧ opens the second layer (rare letters, conjuncts, digits) for one key. Tap ⇧ twice to lock it.

!?# opens symbols. Hold । for a comma.

The strip above the keys suggests words. Tap one to insert it. It learns the words you use, on this phone only.

Hold digits on the ⇧ layer for 0–9. Hold the 🌐 key to pick any keyboard.

The keyboard remembers the words and phrases you use, so its suggestions get better over time. Words you stop using fade out, and a suggestion you pick and then delete is shown less. Everything stays on this phone.
Suggestions go back to the built-in dictionary. This can\'t be undone.
